view.name: Feed list (collapsed)
view.description: The reader's single page: feeds grouped under headings, each a collapsed disclosure showing feed title and URL, with errors and footer at the bottom.

regions.label: H1 title with owl emoji '🦉 Bubo Reader'

Category headings (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects) each with collapsible <details> per feed source showing name + grey feed URL; expanding reveals dated article link list
'Errors' heading with paragraph and bullet list of feeds that failed to parse/fetch
hr, last-updated timestamp, powered-by credit with links and sponsor link

evidence.note: native <details>/<summary> with triangle marker; clicking on live page expanded a list of 12 dated article links in place while other items stayed closed
stack of collapsed disclosure rows under Blogs

patterns.rationale: Content is per-source lists of dated headline links hidden inside disclosures, grouped by category rather than one merged stream; it's an RSS reader's feed listing but not a classic unbounded stream.

evidence.note: expanded live shows '11/15/2026 - Changelog & Friends 118...' date + headline links, newest first

evidence.quote: There were errors trying to parse these feeds:
evidence.note: errors are a plain unstyled section at page bottom, not a banner
links out to articles; no in-app long-form reading surface

structure.layout: single-column unstyled HTML document: h1, category h2 sections with native details/summary disclosure rows, error list, hr footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (browser default sans), headings bold
aesthetics.typeScale: h1 36px bold, h2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular; minimal hierarchy

notes: Essentially browser-default HTML with a tiny stylesheet: only customisation is system-ui 18px font and grey (#aaa) feed URLs after each source name. Native <details> triangles act as disclosure; expanded content is a bulleted list of 'M/D/YYYY - <default blue underlined link>'. Owl emoji as logo. Footer separated by default <hr>, shows build timestamp (static site generator). No nav, no search, no interactivity beyond disclosures.
